items.title: Writing AWS WAF policy for WebBotAuth bots registered with AWS Agent Registry
items.summary: AI bots and crawlers are a growing share of your traffic, and an authentic signature is not the same as a trusted operator. See how AWS WAF Bot Control labels WebBotAuth bots registered with AWS Agent Registry, and how to write Web ACL rules that allow, block, or rate-limit a bot by its verified outcome and registered identity.
items.creator: Prabhakar Varadarajan
